actions.name: AttachInstances
actions.description: Grants permission to attach one or more EC2 instances to the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: AttachLoadBalancerTargetGroups
actions.description: Grants permission to attach one or more target groups to the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: AttachLoadBalancers
actions.description: Grants permission to attach one or more load balancers to the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: AttachTrafficSources
actions.description: Grants permission to attach one or more traffic sources to an Auto Scaling group

actions.name: BatchDeleteScheduledAction
actions.description: Grants permission to delete the specified scheduled actions

actions.name: BatchPutScheduledUpdateGroupAction
actions.description: Grants permission to create or update multiple scheduled scaling actions for an Auto Scaling group

actions.name: CancelInstanceRefresh
actions.description: Grants permission to cancel an instance refresh operation in progress

actions.name: CompleteLifecycleAction
actions.description: Grants permission to complete the lifecycle action for the specified token or instance with the specified result

actions.name: CreateAutoScalingGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to create an Auto Scaling group with the specified name and attributes

actions.name: CreateLaunchConfiguration
actions.description: Grants permission to create a launch configuration

actions.name: CreateOrUpdateTags
actions.description: Grants permission to create or update tags for the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: DeleteAutoScalingGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to delete the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: DeleteLaunchConfiguration
actions.description: Grants permission to delete the specified launch configuration

actions.name: DeleteLifecycleHook
actions.description: Grants permission to deletes the specified lifecycle hook

actions.name: DeleteNotificationConfiguration
actions.description: Grants permission to delete the specified notification

actions.name: DeletePolicy
actions.description: Grants permission to delete the specified Auto Scaling policy

actions.name: DeleteScheduledAction
actions.description: Grants permission to delete the specified scheduled action

actions.name: DeleteTags
actions.description: Grants permission to delete the specified tags

actions.name: DeleteWarmPool
actions.description: Grants permission to delete the warm pool associated with the Auto Scaling group

actions.name: DescribeAccountLimits
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the current Auto Scaling resource limits for your AWS account

actions.name: DescribeAccountSettings
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the current Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling account settings for your account

actions.name: DescribeAdjustmentTypes
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the policy adjustment types for use with PutScalingPolicy

actions.name: DescribeAutoScalingGroups
actions.description: Grants permission to describe one or more Auto Scaling groups. If a list of names is not provided, the call describes all Auto Scaling groups

actions.name: DescribeAutoScalingInstances
actions.description: Grants permission to describe one or more Auto Scaling instances. If a list is not provided, the call describes all instances

actions.name: DescribeAutoScalingNotificationTypes
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the notification types that are supported by Auto Scaling

actions.name: DescribeInstanceRefreshes
actions.description: Grants permission to describe one or more instance refreshes for an Auto Scaling group

actions.name: DescribeLaunchConfigurations
actions.description: Grants permission to describe one or more launch configurations. If you omit the list of names, then the call describes all launch configurations

actions.name: DescribeLifecycleHookTypes
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the available types of lifecycle hooks

actions.name: DescribeLifecycleHooks
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the lifecycle hooks for the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: DescribeLoadBalancerTargetGroups
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the target groups for the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: DescribeLoadBalancers
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the load balancers for the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: DescribeMetricCollectionTypes
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the available CloudWatch metrics for Auto Scaling

actions.name: DescribeNotificationConfigurations
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the notification actions associated with the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: DescribePolicies
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the policies for the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: DescribeScalingActivities
actions.description: Grants permission to describe one or more scaling activities for the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: DescribeScalingProcessTypes
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the scaling process types for use with ResumeProcesses and SuspendProcesses

actions.name: DescribeScheduledActions
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the actions scheduled for your Auto Scaling group that haven't run

actions.name: DescribeTags
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the specified tags

actions.name: DescribeTerminationPolicyTypes
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the termination policies supported by Auto Scaling

actions.name: DescribeTrafficSources
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the target groups for the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: DescribeWarmPool
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the warm pool associated with the Auto Scaling group

actions.name: DetachInstances
actions.description: Grants permission to remove one or more instances from the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: DetachLoadBalancerTargetGroups
actions.description: Grants permission to detach one or more target groups from the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: DetachLoadBalancers
actions.description: Grants permission to remove one or more load balancers from the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: DetachTrafficSources
actions.description: Grants permission to detach one or more traffic sources from an Auto Scaling group

actions.name: DisableMetricsCollection
actions.description: Grants permission to disable monitoring of the specified metrics for the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: EnableMetricsCollection
actions.description: Grants permission to enable monitoring of the specified metrics for the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: EnterStandby
actions.description: Grants permission to move the specified instances into Standby mode

actions.name: ExecutePolicy
actions.description: Grants permission to execute the specified policy

actions.name: ExitStandby
actions.description: Grants permission to move the specified instances out of Standby mode

actions.name: GetPredictiveScalingForecast
actions.description: Grants permission to retrieve the forecast data for a predictive scaling policy

actions.name: LaunchInstances
actions.description: Grants permission to launch one or more EC2 instances in the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: PutAccountSetting
actions.description: Grants permission to modify an account setting for your account

actions.name: PutLifecycleHook
actions.description: Grants permission to create or update a lifecycle hook for the specified Auto Scaling Group

actions.name: PutNotificationConfiguration
actions.description: Grants permission to configure an Auto Scaling group to send notifications when specified events take place

actions.name: PutScalingPolicy
actions.description: Grants permission to create or update a policy for an Auto Scaling group

actions.name: PutScheduledUpdateGroupAction
actions.description: Grants permission to create or update a scheduled scaling action for an Auto Scaling group

actions.name: PutWarmPool
actions.description: Grants permission to create or update the warm pool associated with the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat
actions.description: Grants permission to record a heartbeat for the lifecycle action associated with the specified token or instance

actions.name: ResumeProcesses
actions.description: Grants permission to resume the specified suspended Auto Scaling processes, or all suspended process, for the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: RollbackInstanceRefresh
actions.description: Grants permission to rollback an instance refresh operation in progress

actions.name: SetDesiredCapacity
actions.description: Grants permission to set the size of the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: SetInstanceHealth
actions.description: Grants permission to set the health status of the specified instance

actions.name: SetInstanceProtection
actions.description: Grants permission to update the instance protection settings of the specified instances

actions.name: StartInstanceRefresh
actions.description: Grants permission to start a new instance refresh operation

actions.name: SuspendProcesses
actions.description: Grants permission to suspend the specified Auto Scaling processes, or all processes, for the specified Auto Scaling group

actions.name: TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to terminate the specified instance and optionally adjust the desired group size

actions.name: UpdateAutoScalingGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to update the configuration for the specified Auto Scaling group
